row:
Skelian Chiropractic Clinic is a multi-award wining chiropractic clinic based in Cheltenham, UK. The chiropractors at the clinic have been helping the local community with musculoskeletal problems for over 20 years. Over these years we have provided the highest standards of care to our patients. 

Chiropractic is a healthcare profession that specialises in the diagnosis and treatment of conditions involving the muscles, bones, joints and nerves of the body. Although chiropractors are best known for treating back and neck pain, they also treat a wide range of other musculoskeletal conditions, for which the evidence base is fairly broad across a range of musculoskeletal complaints, for example:

+ Acute and Chronic Back Pain
+ Sciatica
+ Mechanical Neck Pain
+ Cervicogenic Headache
+ Prevention of Migraine
+ Minor Sports Injuries
+ Joint Pain
+ Shoulder Complaints
+ Elbow Pain
+ Ankle Sprains
